description.value: MEC (Mountain Equipment Company) is Canada's largest outdoor specialty retailer, and this Victoria location on Government Street is a major outdoor gear hub in the city centre. The store carries cycling equipment, apparel, and accessories alongside a broad range of outdoor gear. Touring cyclists passing through Victoria will find it a convenient resupply point for kit and consumables.
